cs.t:
In the last year:
Sennheiser 660s and a Schiit Stack (I wear headphones almost constantly while working and this was more than worth it). iMovr sit stand desk, at the start of the pandemic I was using the desk built into my apartment wall that was probably fine for the occasional use at the family computer when this house was built in the 90s but was causing me a lot of pain using day to day. Over Two Years, stupidest thing that has probably brought me the most happiness is a yutanpo I bought off of Amazon (also called hot water bottle?). There is something so satisfying about jumping into a nice pre-warmed and cozy bed at the end of a cold winter's day. (Though technically it was a gift so I don't know if it counts).
cs.th: Ask HN: Favorite purchases of last two years?
